verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of exporting results to documents (e.g. PDF/DOCX), spreadsheets (CSV/XLSX), or reference-manager formats (BibTeX/RIS/Zotero). The Markdown notes and reports in docs-6 are created and kept inside the workspace, and the API and MCP access cover programmatic integration rather than file export. Neither demonstrates the export capability the story asks for.
